name: One Draenei's Junk...
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Well, after that display of voracious greed, I feel nauseous.

Regardless, I shall not dwell too long on your material addiction.

For each imperfect draenethyst fragment you turn in, I shall reward you with more junk. My junk heap gets smaller while your junk heap gets larger. On Draenor we call this a 'win-win' situation.
narrative.objectives: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You truly disgust me, friend. A grown woman drooling over a pile of junk? Pitiful! Take your reward and get out of my sight.

Sounds familiar? It should, because I say it a thousand times per day.

Oh how I loathe this world.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Well? Draenethyst? Remember?

<Kum'isha clenches his fist and knocks on your head.>

Is anybody home?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 55, 5,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Everything Counts In Large Amounts
quests.objectiveText: Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
